claim.claim-text: wherein the bottom cover (100) includes: - an upper edge and lateral edges fitted between the side part of the cabinet and the at least one first fitting rib at an upper portion

- at least one first latch coupling portion (110) coupled with the at least one first latch protrusion (210) of the cabinet (200), and wherein the back cover (500) includes a lower edge fitted between the at least one second fitting rib (220) and the side part of the cabinet at a lower portion.
2. The display apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising: at least one protrusion protruding from the at least one second fitting rib toward the side part of the cabinet.

3. The display apparatus according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the back cover is coupled to the rear side of the bottom cover such that an upper edge of the back cover contacts a middle portion of the rear side of the bottom cover.
4. The display apparatus according to claim 3, further comprising: a screw member passing through a screw hole formed at an upper portion of the back cover and coupled to the bottom cover.
5. The display apparatus according to claim 3 or 4, wherein the upper edge and lateral edges of the back cover couples to the bottom cover.
6. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 5, wherein a gap exists between the at least one first fitting rib and a bottom edge of the bottom cover.

7. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the bottom cover further comprises at least one latch guide slop or at least one latch guide groove in front of the at least one first latch coupling portion to guide an insertion of the at least one first latch protrusion to the at least one first latch coupling portion.
8. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the bottom cover is made of metal.
9. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the second portion of the bottom cover comprises a color-coated layer.

10. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the cabinet includes at least one second latch protrusion disposed on a lower side part of the cabinet, and wherein the back cover includes at least one second latch coupling portion hook-coupled with the at least one second latch protrusion.
11. The display apparatus according to one of claims 1 to 10, further comprising:

a panel guide guiding a mounting of the display panel on the bottom cover, wherein at least a portion of the cabinet is exposed to an outside of the display apparatus, and at least a portion of the cabinet contacts the panel guide.
